maria (Docs): Quick question — I opened PR #4827 to refresh the Hello quickstart auth snippet. I noticed the token flow uses the old SDK v2 pattern, but our examples are moving to header-based auth. Can someone confirm the preferred pattern for the guide?

tao (DevEx): saw it. prefer header/env var pattern for the top-level quickstart (simpler to copy). we should still keep an SDK example that picks up the key from env. i'll craft a patch.

sam (Eng): heads up — the hello-demo deploy script still uses `--model-id`. the new runtime accepts `--model`. i'll push a tiny CLI fix to match docs.

maria (Docs): proposed snippet for the quickstart (minimal):

```
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hello world")
print(resp.text)
```

use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var in the copyable example, avoid inline keys.

tao (DevEx): tiny nit: prefer `client = Client()` with the SDK reading the env automatically to reduce friction. also add a 1-line note about token scopes if needed.

jess (PM): putting this on Monday's docs sprint — goal: merge by EOD Tue. tagging reviewers.

deploy-bot: build/preview for PR #4827 succeeded — preview URL: https://deploy.preview/redwood/4827 (status: green)

sam (Eng): pushed #4829 to update `scripts/deploy.sh` (now accepts `--model \"redwood/1\"`). referenced #4827 in the commit message.

maria (Docs): thanks — i'll update the PR to use `Client()` with env fallback and mention the CLI flag change. any objections to removing the legacy v2 snippet?

tao (DevEx): ok to remove the v2 example, but please add a short \"Migration from SDK v2\" note with a link to the migration guide. keeps searchers happy.

maria (Docs): added a 3-line migration note and a code diff block in the PR — also added a test harness snippet for local verification. ready for review. :sparkles:

jess (PM): looks good from product — approved.

sam (Eng): reviewed the doc changes, left one tiny wording nit, then approved.

maria (Docs): addressed wording nit, squashed commits, and merged PR #4827. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
